answer: A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The hollow counter is kept in inlet and zenith publishes each reset. An copycat hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1053 identities would post 3274 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
